body.heading: About this sheet
paragraphs: Free SparkKindly Kids coloring printable: Rainy Day.
A big, friendly coloring page with bold outlines that are easy for small hands to stay inside — or to decorate completely their own way.

body.heading: How to use it
paragraphs: Print the sheet, choose crayons, pencils or markers, and color the picture. There are no wrong colors: a purple sun is a great sun.

takeaway: Coloring builds hand strength, patience and focus — and every finished page is a small piece of art to be proud of.
supervision: Stay nearby and color along if you like — side-by-side coloring is a calm way to chat about the day.
safetyNotes: Use non-toxic crayons and markers made for children.
Print at 100% size (not "fit to page") so the sheet keeps its true size and the pictures stay the size they were drawn.
screenFreeExtension: Take the finished page on a walk and hunt for the real thing it shows — a leaf, a star, a friendly dog — then add one detail you spotted to the picture.
